## Link-label hiding — implemented

**File changed (only):** `src/views/editor/layout.rs` (+66/−21, uncommitted, additive only)

**What:** `elided()` (`layout.rs:658`) now hides `[` + `](url)` of a `[text](url)` link on non-live lines, leaving the label alone, Typora-style. Concretely:
- `urls[]` collects the `[` and `](url)` ranges per link via the existing `md::links()` + `md::web_link()` (single pass).
- `kept()` relaxes to `… && !addressed(i)`; a new `hidden_byte()` predicate also elides `QUIET` bytes when they are link addresses (previously all `QUIET` bytes were never elided — that's what kept addresses readable). Inline-code bytes (`CODE`) still never hide, and images (`![…](…)`), bare URLs, wikilinks, tags, comments, callouts keep their source.
- **Reveal UX:** no new affordance needed — the existing cursor-line/click/edit mechanism (`revealed`, `mouse.rs:628`, edit path) already shows source on the live line; link hiding rides it. `links.rs:36` ("make link" selects the URL) works through the source↔display map.
- **Find/search contract:** markers are display-elided via the `subs` map, never removed from source, so search over source bytes is unaffected (same mechanism as existing marker hiding).
- **Tests updated/extended in-file:** `hidden("[t](https://example.com)")` → `["[", "](https://example.com)"]`; new `hidden("see https://example.com here") == []`; load-state `rows[12]` is now `("our link", false)`; click-reveal coverage added (click link line → full source live + others hidden; click back on bold line → address hides again).

**Verification:**
- Full `cargo test` is impossible in this environment: `cargo` fails building `gpui` — `xcrun: error: unable to find utility "metal"` (no Xcode toolchain; same blocker as prior lanes). **CI must prove** the gpui suite.
- What I ran instead (all green): extracted the exact final `elided()` + real `logic/markdown` sources into a scratch crate (`/tmp/linkhide`, edition 2024 + regex dep) and asserted every real `hidden()` expectation from the test module (unchanged ones) plus new edge cases — **ALL LINKHIDE HARNESS CHECKS PASSED**, including: link in inline code keeps source (only backticks hide); two links on one line; `[t](note)` non-protocol stays; `![a](p.png)` and spaced-path images stay; bare URL/wikilink/tag/comment/callout unchanged.
- `rustfmt`: system rustfmt predates edition-2024 let-chains so `--check` can't run standalone; `cargo fmt` reformatted 6 unrelated files (pre-existing drift) — I reverted all of those; the final diff is `layout.rs` only and follows surrounding style. (Note: repo-wide `cargo fmt` dirt exists independent of me — integrator may want to pin/normalize.)

## Mermaid kind coverage — assessment (no code changed)

- **Gap confirmed.** `logic/mermaid.rs`: `Kind::{Class, Sequence, State}` only; `kind()` returns `None` for `graph TD`, `flowchart LR`, `pie`, etc. — pinned by an explicit test (`kind(...).is_none() && to_diagram(...).is_none()` for flowchart/graph/pie). This is the *to-canvas converter* only.
- **Display side is complete:** `ui/figure.rs:43` renders via `mermaid_rs_renderer` (full engine; its own test renders `flowchart LR`), so flowcharts/ER display fine in the viewer — they just can't "Edit on the canvas" (`viewer.rs:586` hides the pencil unless `kind().is_some()`; `shell/diagrams.rs:241` silently no-ops; MCP `draw.rs:26` returns the `FLOW` error naming exactly the three supported kinds).
- **Sketch (spec, not implemented):** Option A — extend the converter incrementally: flowchart/graph first (nodes→`Form::Round/Rect`, edges→links, reuse `layered()`; subgraph→composite), ER second (entities→rect compartments, relationships→labeled links; needs crow's-foot relation kinds). Keep `skipped` counting and the `made()` round-trip test pattern. Option B — renderer swap (parse `mermaid_rs_renderer` SVG back into shapes): lossy, large, not recommended; render-only is already the status quo. Recommend A, flowchart first. Estimated still LARGE (new converters + tests), belongs in its own slice.

## REPORT — overlaps (not resolved, per brief)

- I touched only `elided()` + its tests in `layout.rs`/`grid.rs`/`mouse.rs` territory. Sibling lanes (footnotes writer, code-hide writer) share these files — my hunks are: `elided` doc/`urls`/`kept`/`hidden_byte` block (~line 657–712) and test fns `elided_markers_hide_off_live`, `markers_hide_until_the_line_is_clicked_or_edited`. Integrator: rebase/merge on those regions.
- No removals, no `Cargo.toml`, no shared registries touched. Branch `agent/feat-linkhide` left with uncommitted changes as instructed — nothing pushed, nothing committed.

## Open questions

1. Should wikilink brackets (`[[note]]`) also hide off-live? Left readable (out of scope); easy follow-up in the same `urls` mechanism.
2. `[text](url)` where URL contains `)` — `web_link` already punts (stays readable); unchanged behavior, flagging only.
3. `cargo fmt` drift in 6 untouched files suggests the repo's fmt baseline predates the toolchain — worth an integrator decision before multiple writer lanes land.
